rows.text: Roll again if the captain is at a space port, otherwise an Objective Item has been found that may be required for the current mission (check the away mission’s details). If it’s not needed, it is in- stead an ancient alien artefact (AAA) worth 100c.
Use to gain +4 damage to your next damage roll when using a Dex weapon.
Use to gain +4 damage to your next damage roll when using a Str weapon.
Use to add +4 Def against enemy’s next damage roll.
Roll on table A – Armour and add “(XL)” before its name. It gains +0.6 Def and gains +300 credit to its value and 60 credits to its fix cost.
Use to deduct -5 pips from the acid track.
Use to replenish up to 10 lost HP.
Use to add +20 Int to next test.
Use to add +20 Str to next test.
Use to add +20 Dex to next test.
Use to deduct -5 pips from the plague track.
Roll on table I – Implants +10 for the patch that is found. Add “Patch” after its name when you add it to the log sheet.
Use to add +20 to a result when rolling on the next table.
Use to gain 3 karma point.
Use to gain +20 Int until you next shade a pip on the time track.
Use to gain +20 Str until you next shade a pip on the time track.
Use to gain +20 Dex until you next shade a pip on the time track.
Use to gain 3 point of primary Dex.
Use to gain 3 point of primary Int.
Use to gain 3 point of primary Str.
Use to gain 3 point of primary HP.
Roll on table W – Weapon and add “(XL)” before its name. Add +4 to its Dmg value. It gains +1200 credit to its value.
Roll on table I – Implants +10 for the implant that is found.
Use to gain 3 Life point.
Roll on each of the following tables once, TA - Trappings A -3,  TB - Trappings B -3, and TC - Trappings C -3.
Powered armour has been found. Roll on table A – Armour +10 for the armour and then on table P - Powers +10 for its power and adjust its value.
A powered weapon has been found. Roll on table W – Weapons +10 for the weapon and then on table P - Powers +10 for its power and adjust its value.
